answer.rationale: The pair is one key compared with itself, so the question is whether all the 'Lionel' mentions are one teacher. Stated countries (France, Guadeloupe/SXM) and styles (Kizomba/Semba) hint at a single Kizomba teacher, but the bare first name 'Lionel' appears across Norway, Spain, Saint Martin and France with no partner or full name to tie them together, so it cannot be settled either way.
